observations: Photo 0: Front view of a black DSLR body with 'Canon' and 'EOS 650D' printed on it, mounted with a kit lens marked 'Canon' and zoom scale 18-55mm; lens front cap is on, so the glass element is not visible.

Photo 1: Rear view held in a palm; LCD screen appears closed/folded flat against the body and looks dark/blank, so it is unclear if it powers on; viewfinder, MENU/INFO buttons, and a 4-way dial with WB/SET/AF are visible; no visible cracks or major scuffs on the back shell.

Photo 2: Top view showing the zoom ring markings (18-24-35-55), the mode dial (M, Av, Tv, P, Auto, Off/On), ISO button, hot-shoe, and a focal-length scale on the lens barrel; stabilizer switch position is not clearly readable.
No shot shows the camera powered on, no sample image taken with it, no battery or SD card visible, no charger shown, and no shutter-count or menu screen is shown.
Watermarks 'MCSTEVE' and 'POSTED ON JIJI' are overlaid on all three photos, consistent with a listing reposted on Jiji; this does not itself prove or disprove anything about the item.

read_from: photo 2 lens barrel text 'Canon' and zoom scale 18-55mm

Close-up photos of both lens elements (front and rear) with caps removed

response.reason: The item is clearly identified as a Canon EOS 650D body with an 18-55mm kit lens from readable text in the photos, so it can be priced at its worst case: cosmetically presentable but functionally unverified (treated as not confirmed working, lens condition unknown, no accessories shown).
